caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: bearish, mid range · 1d: transition, above range · 4h: range, above range · 1h: range, above range · 15m: bullish, above range. Timeframes disagree, which is ordinary: they describe different horizons and both readings can be correct at once. 1w is bearish while 15m is bullish.
